fusions.name: Peg Driven Home
fusions.desc: You bring the staff down two-handed on an enemy at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank, dealing 28 damage and using up every affliction on it to add their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Levelling Blow
fusions.desc: You slam the staff flat against the ground, dealing 15 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each 2.5 tiles back. Each has a 30% chance to be [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Weighted Head
fusions.desc: You choke down to the end of the staff and swing it as a maul: your blunt damage rises 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Flattened Guard
fusions.desc: Your blunt damage, staff blows among them, cannot be resisted, and ignores 12% of the target's armour.
